# AIBAST Agents Library API

> Everything in the AIBAST Agents Library as static JSON, for AI agents first and people second: each solution, its demo, how to get it, how to learn it and its proof.

Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.

Site: https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/
Raw fallback: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/

## Start here
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/paths.html: choose a path with a shareable preview before starting.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/paths.json: questions, prerequisite checks and every tutorial destination.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/index.json: where to start, counts and every endpoint.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/search.json: one line per solution (72). Find the right one here.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/solutions/<slug>.json: everything about one solution: what it is, try it, get it, learn it, proof.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/scenarios/<id>.json: one demo question with its recorded answer (384 recorded).
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/media/index.json: every screenshot and narration clip, by solution, with sha256. These files are served from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/ (pinned to the published commit), not from Pages.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/solutions/_shared/aibast-sdk.js: one script for pages (AibastLibrary, AibastMedia, AibastDemo); guide in docs/sdk.md.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/registry.json: every endpoint with its SHA-256 and a permanent copy under api/versions/.

## To show a solution
Open the solution's try.page. It plays the recorded demo in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork or Copilot Studio.
Every answer is a recorded sample answer. Questions outside the recorded ones are not answered.

## To deploy a solution
Read get.prompt in the solution document, replace {pages} with https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/, and follow it.
It asks the user once before changing anything. Check every download against its sha256.

## Learn RAPP step by step
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/rapp/index.json: the 14 RAPP production steps, 33 concepts, glossary and experimental tools.
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/rapp/steps/<n>.json: step n (1-14): do (what to do), get (what you get), proof (how you know), explain (the longer note).
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/rapp/concepts/<slug>.json, https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/rapp/glossary.json, https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/rapp/tools.json.
To teach a step, read its document and explain do, get and proof in plain words. Each document lists its source files with sha256.

## Public Microsoft content
- https://microsoft.github.io/aibast-agents-library/api/v1/public/index.json: values read exactly from public Microsoft pages, each with its source URL and sha256. First: api/v1/public/copilot-credit-rates.json (planning estimate, not a price quote).

## Rules
- Sample data only. Never connect a library solution to an organization's own data.
- Same-site reads use relative paths. Do not bypass the cache.
